system.v1.GetVersionResponse.description: GetVersionResponse identifies the exact build the environment serves.

commit.description: Full 40-character lowercase hexadecimal source revision of the build.
commit.title: commit

environment.description:
Environment that answered: "devnet", "testnet" or "mainnet", or "local"
 for a development stack.
environment.title: environment

version.description:
Version of the exact build. A release reports its version in
 MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH form, such as "0.10.0". A build made after a release
 appends the number of source revisions since that release and "g" with
 the first 12 hexadecimal digits of its own revision, such as
 "0.10.0-12-g4e21a2f09670": 12 revisions after release 0.10.0. Releases
 before mainnet are 0.MINOR.PATCH; mainnet starts at 1.0.0.
version.title: version

system.v1.GetVersionResponse.title: GetVersionResponse

BrokerApiKeyAuth.description: Broker API key, sent as a bearer token and accepted only by the QuickSwap broker API. The broker API key is a server credential. Call this API from the broker's backend, never from a browser or mobile app. The broker's members create, rotate and revoke keys through the QuickSwap broker API, and a key may rotate itself.

info.title: Polyester API
